title: feat(access): Studio permission matrix — first screen sees the matrix (#2600 B1)
body:
## What

**Issue #2600 · B1 (设计迭代 · 首屏见矩阵)** — the Access pillar is called *权限矩阵 (Permission Matrix)*, but the editor opened with a name/label form plus the system-capability picker's option chips, pushing the matrix header a screen-and-a-half down. This collapses the two low-frequency, high-chrome sections so the matrix reaches the first screen.

### Changes
- **Identity (name/label) → collapsible summary.** Collapsed by default to a one-line row (`label · provenance · default/read-only badges`), expands on click. The api-name already sits in the PageShell breadcrumb (font-mono), so the summary carries the human label only — no duplication.
- **Zero-grant capabilities → "none · add" affordance.** A writable set with no grants used to render all 7 capability options as outline chips, which read as *already-owned*. It now shows `系统能力 · 无附加系统能力 · + 添加能力`; the picker opens on demand. Granted sets and read-only sets keep the inline picker unchanged.

Not touched: the read-only lock (#2570), the dirty-nav guards (#2588/#2606), the history sheet + breadcrumb (#2599).

## Verify
Live walkthrough on a real showcase backend (writable `com.example.writabletest` + read-only `com.example.showcase`):
- Collapsed default → matrix header rises to ~⅓ down (was below the fold).
- Click identity summary → name/label inputs appear; **+ 添加能力** → full picker appears.
- Read-only package still fully locks (matrix + expand shows disabled inputs).

## Tests
- New `PermissionMatrixEditor.basics.test.tsx` (collapse default / expand identity / zero-grant capability collapse / granted stays inline).
- Updated settle points + read-only expand in the existing matrix suites (badge / embedded / readonly) and both Studio guard suites (accessGuard / pillarNavGuard) — identity is now summary text, not an input.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor*` + `StudioDesignSurface.accessGuard` + `StudioDesignSurface.pillarNavGuard` + OWD/emptyPackage/scope: **58 tests green**.
